name: Grok Bot Notify
description: Hands Orca's agent alerts (done, waiting, blocked) from Orca's agent.status.changed hook to Grok Bot. The alert half of orca-helm.

settings.title: Routes (one Grok Bot per line)
settings.description: One line per bot: name | workspaces | routine URL | Authorization. Copy the URL and the Authorization value from that bot's Grok Bot routine screen. Workspaces are comma-separated repo names, worktree names or path parts (case-insensitive; empty means every workspace). On save the Authorization value moves to encrypted secrets and the line ends in (saved). A new line for the same name replaces the old one. # starts a comment.

settings.title: Grok Bot routine URL
settings.description: Only while Routes is empty: one routine URL that gets every workspace's alerts.

settings.title: Authorization value
settings.description: Only while Routes is empty: the Authorization value for the URL above. Paste it once; the worker moves it into encrypted secrets and clears this field.

settings.title: States
settings.description: Comma-separated agent states to hand to Grok Bot: done, waiting, blocked, working.

settings.title: Debounce seconds
settings.description: Seconds to hold back the same state again for the same terminal. A state change in between resets it.
